_comment: Global Health Radar source registry. access_method: api | rss | html_listing | page_monitor | manual. Official APIs/feeds are preferred; page_monitor only detects that a page changed and queues it for human review (no fields are extracted). manual = no automated access (blocked, login, or invitation-only). Checked 2026-10-25.
user_agent: YIGH-Radar/1.0 (Yale Institute for Global Health; research use)

sources.name: Grants.gov
sources.covers: All US federal opportunities: NIH (incl. Fogarty), CDC, State Dept Bureau of Global Health Security & Diplomacy, USDA, NSF, etc.
sources.notes: Official public REST API (no key). Searched with the YIGH priority query sets; details verified with fetchOpportunity. robots.txt not applicable to the API; we still rate-limit to 1 request/second.

sources.name: NIH Guide for Grants and Contracts
sources.covers: Newly published NIH NOFOs (RFA, PAR, PA) and notices.
sources.notes: Official RSS feed. NOFO numbers are looked up on Grants.gov for structured deadline/amount/eligibility; RSS-only items are flagged for review.

sources.name: IDRC funding calls
sources.notes: No public API or feed found. Server-rendered listing; robots.txt allows /en/funding. Details are extracted from each call's official page and always flagged for review.

sources.name: Wellcome funding schemes
sources.notes: No public API/feed. Listing is rendered client-side, so fields can't be read reliably; changes to the page are queued for manual review. robots.txt Crawl-delay: 10 is honoured.

sources.name: Grand Challenges grant opportunities (Gates Foundation & partners)
sources.notes: Server-rendered listing of Grand Challenges initiatives (Gates Foundation and partners) with status and description per call. Replaces the client-rendered gcgh.grandchallenges.org page. robots.txt allows all.

sources.name: Grand Challenges Canada
sources.notes: Client-rendered listing; monitored for changes.

sources.name: Fogarty International Center funding
sources.notes: Fogarty NOFOs are collected via Grants.gov; this page is monitored for programme announcements not yet posted there.

sources.name: EDCTP3 Global Health Partnership
sources.notes: Calls are published on the EU Funding & Tenders portal, which has a search API; not yet enabled until its terms are reviewed.

sources.name: Rockefeller Foundation grants
sources.notes: Requests for proposals are posted on /rfps/ as PDF documents, so the page is monitored and each change queued for review. The site's RSS feed carries articles, not calls, so it is not used for discovery. Most grants are by invitation.

sources.name: Gates Foundation
sources.notes: No public open-call listing: gatesfoundation.org's former grant-opportunities page returns 404 and most grants are by invitation. Open calls are collected through Grand Challenges (gates-grand-challenges).

sources.name: Coefficient Giving (formerly Open Philanthropy)
sources.notes: Every URL (funds page, robots.txt, RSS, sitemap; also openphilanthropy.org) returns HTTP 403 to automated requests and to fetch tools (checked 2026-10-26); not bypassed. Third-party listings (not verified) mention: the Science & Global Health R&D fund (described as rolling), and RFPs on global health in an era of transformative AI (closed 21 Aug 2026), Launchpad Funds (EOIs closed 2 Oct 2026) and global lead poisoning research (closed 2 Aug 2026). Check https://coefficientgiving.org/funds/ manually in a browser before relying on any of these.

sources.name: NIHR Global Health Research
sources.notes: Returns HTTP 403 to automated requests; not bypassed.

sources.name: Unitaid calls for proposals
sources.notes: Returns HTTP 403 to automated requests; not bypassed.

sources.name: CEPI calls for proposals
sources.notes: Calls page URL changed (old URL 404); confirm the current page before enabling a monitor.

sources.name: Lever for Change open calls (incl. MacArthur 100&Change)
sources.notes: Lever for Change (a MacArthur Foundation affiliate) runs big-bet competitions for many donors, including MacArthur's 100&Change. Server-rendered listing; robots.txt has no restrictions. Health-related calls are kept.

sources.name: MacArthur 100&Change timeline
sources.notes: 100&Change runs as a periodic $100M competition; the timeline page is monitored so the next round's opening is flagged. MacArthur Big Bets (AI Opportunity, Climate Solutions, etc.) are invitation-only. robots.txt disallows only /grants/ and search pages.

sources.name: Hewlett Foundation grantmaking
sources.notes: Mostly invitation-only. robots.txt disallows /grants/, so the allowed grantmaking page is monitored. Checked 2026-10-26. robots.txt allows this page.

sources.name: Packard Foundation — for grantseekers
sources.notes: Dedicated RFP page (server-rendered). On 2026-10-26 it stated: no open RFPs. Mostly invitation-only. Checked 2026-10-26.

sources.name: Ford Foundation grant opportunities
sources.notes: Server-rendered 'Current Opportunities' section; on 2026-10-26 it stated there are currently no public grant opportunities. Most grants are identified by the foundation; no unsolicited proposals.

sources.name: Bloomberg Philanthropies — public health
sources.notes: Partnership-based; monitored for public announcements. The old grant-opportunities URL returns 404. Checked 2026-10-26. robots.txt allows this page.

sources.name: Chan Zuckerberg Initiative — science
sources.notes: RFAs are announced from the science pages (the old /rfa/ URL returns 404); page is client-rendered, so it is monitored. Checked 2026-10-26. robots.txt allows this page.

sources.name: Novo Nordisk Foundation grants
sources.notes: Open calls (incl. Global Health) are listed here but rendered client-side, so the page is monitored. Checked 2026-10-26. robots.txt allows this page.

sources.name: Robert Wood Johnson Foundation — active funding opportunities
sources.notes: US-focused; listing is client-rendered, so it is monitored. Checked 2026-10-26. robots.txt allows this page.

sources.name: Conrad N. Hilton Foundation grants
sources.notes: Mostly invitation-only. Checked 2026-10-26. robots.txt allows this page.

sources.name: HHMI open competitions
sources.notes: Investigator and fellowship competitions. Checked 2026-10-26. robots.txt allows this page.

sources.name: Doris Duke Foundation — medical research
sources.notes: 'Open grant competitions' list with deadlines (server-rendered). Accepts some unsolicited proposals via letter of inquiry. Checked 2026-10-26.

sources.name: Google.org opportunities
sources.notes: Page renders no content without JavaScript, so a change monitor could never detect anything. Check https://www.google.org/opportunities/ manually. Checked 2026-10-26.

sources.name: WHO/TDR grants
sources.notes: Implementation-research grants and training calls for LMIC researchers; listing is client-rendered. Checked 2026-10-26. robots.txt allows this page.

sources.name: Gavi — work with us
sources.notes: Gavi's RFPs, expressions of interest and consulting opportunities page. Checked 2026-10-26.

sources.name: Global Fund business opportunities
sources.notes: Official Markdown version of the page. Mostly procurement tenders for the Geneva secretariat; research usually happens through country grants. Checked 2026-10-26.

sources.name: Skoll Foundation awards
sources.notes: robots.txt disallows automated access to this page; awards are by nomination. Check manually. Checked 2026-10-26.

sources.name: Pfizer Foundation
sources.notes: Returns HTTP 403 to automated requests; grants are by invitation. Not bypassed. Checked 2026-10-26.

sources.name: Johnson & Johnson Foundation
sources.notes: Page is an empty client-side shell for automated requests; grants are by invitation. Check manually. Checked 2026-10-26.

sources.name: Children's Investment Fund Foundation
sources.notes: No open-call page; grants are by invitation. Check manually. Checked 2026-10-26.

sources.name: Mastercard Foundation
sources.notes: Partnership-based; no calls-for-proposals page (that URL returns 404). Check manually. Checked 2026-10-26.

sources.name: Aga Khan Foundation / AKDN
sources.notes: Partnership-based; no open-call listing. Check manually. Checked 2026-10-26.
